entry.title: b12245: llama : apply the iGPU lazy-mode fallback only when mmap is off (#31957)
entry.summary: On a device without mmap support, --lazy-mode auto resolved to off even with --load-mode mmap, so llama_prefetch_rows never ran and the rows of the large tensors faulted in one page at a time. Resolve it to off only when mmap is off; the default iGPU load path is unchanged. Fixes #31943
